tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List every market (kind of AI API) that has prices, with its id and pricing unit. Start here to find the market id.

tools.name: describe_market
tools.description: Explain one market: what it is, how its pricing works, and the attributes you can filter and compare on (with plain-language help).

tools.name: search_offerings
tools.description: Rank the offerings in one market by price, quality and speed, with optional requirements and a maximum price. Returns prices with their verification date and source.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Full detail for one offering: description, capabilities, current price with its source, and price history.

tools.name: compare_offerings
tools.description: Put 2 to 4 offerings from the same market side by side: prices, scores and every capability.
